thread:
anya - PM: Quick sync: want to lock down a lightweight playbook for concordance gating on Optimize recommendations (batching / caching / quant). Customers ask for explainability when quant profiles change.

sam - Eng: Agree. We need clear launch criteria: performance tolerances, latency SLO pass rate, and a tested rollback plan.

li - ML: Proposal: two-signal quality gate. 1) automated concordance score on canonical eval set per customer. 2) live mismatch signal from sampled production responses. If concordance drops > 2% -> fire alert and suspend recommendations.

maria - Solutions: Customers hate noise. Recommend staged opt-in: internal alpha -> closed pilot (3 customers) -> broader opt-in GA. Pilot contracts must include rollback and an "explain" payload.

anya - PM: Stages: alpha (internal), closed pilot (3 customers), gradual GA opt-in. Must provide a human-readable justification for each recommendation.

sam - Eng: Tech note: runtime will tag each rec with metadata: quant_profile, batch_policy, cache_policy. That lets us join metrics server-side for drift analysis.

li - ML: Eval alerting should be per-customer canonical prompt set. Two thresholds: automated concordance (batch eval) and live delta on sampled A/B queries.

maria - Solutions: For pilots, ship a customer FAQ + opt-out flag. Dashboard should surface tokens saved, p95 latency delta, concordance delta, and reversible action.

devops-bot: deploy 1717104500 started -> canary to "optimize-pilot" pool

sam - Eng: Launch criteria draft:
- Concordance delta <= 1.5% vs baseline on customer prompt set
- Median token cost reduction >= 8% on pilot traffic
- Error rate increase <= 0.1% over 24h
- Rollback playbook exercised in staging

li - ML: Add sample-level heuristic: if token-level surprise/perplexity increases beyond threshold, suppress quant recommendation for that model/route.

anya - PM: Sprint checklist (prioritized):
1) Canonical prompt sets defined per-customer (maria + customer eng) - owner: maria
2) Runtime rec metadata instrumentation (sam)
3) Eval pipeline alert hook + dashboard (li + eng-obs)
4) Customer explainer + opt-out UI (maria + UX)
5) Pilot recruitment & comms (anya)

maria - Solutions: I'll ping pilot candidates: AcmeHealth, ComposeAI, TutorLabs. I'll draft the FAQ and the explainer payload.

sam - Eng: Constraint: quant variants need GPU perf validation. Start with int8 profiles to limit surface area.

li - ML: Caching interactions: prefix caching can change outputs; need to tag contexts where caching is applied and run evals with cache enabled.

anya - PM: Decision: pilot will target int8 + caching heuristics. Must include an "explain" JSON in API: reason, estimated cost savings, observed concordance delta.

maria - Solutions: Customers ask how we measure "user-facing" regressions. Suggest tracking customer-specific KPIs (task success, completion length, proxy signals) and a small A/B harness.

li - ML: We'll add A/B routing for sampled queries to measure downstream KPI differences.

sam - Eng: Risks: rollout complexity, telemetry volume blowup. Mitigation: sample-level telemetry + aggregated deltas, backpressure on telemetry.

eng-obs: We'll stub a dashboard showing token savings, latency deltas, concordance over time, and a per-recommendation tile with rollback button.

anya - PM: Action owners & due dates:
- maria: pilot outreach + prompt sets by Tue next week
- sam: runtime tagging + canary deploy by Fri
- li: eval hook + alert config prototype by Fri
- eng-obs: dashboard stub by Mon

maria - Solutions: ack, drafting FAQ and customer comms.

li - ML: ack, will open PR for concordance metric defs.

sam - Eng: ack, will add per-customer feature flag and rollback automation.

anya - PM: Reconvene Wed 11:00 to review pilot readiness. :thumbsup:
